verdict.rationale: Resend's docs say you can point MX records at Resend and process inbound messages via webhooks (resend-docs-11), and the API can list received emails (resend-docs-27). That covers the core of the inbound-mail story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the payload includes parsed headers, body and attachments; any detail on the inbound webhook payload format; independent or hands-on corroboration of inbound receiving.
